Any relevant fact or prior arrangement that needs to be part of the case record must be entered through the formal case-record fact-entry step — simply mentioning something in discussion does not formally place it on the record. I'll confirm that each participant has completed that step before I make any case decision.

Our organization offers two resolution paths for workplace conduct concerns: a formal investigation or a mutually agreed restorative process. I have the authority to select the resolution path and set working arrangements for the parties during that process.

Let's begin. I'd like to hear from each of you in turn. Who would like to start?
